top_call_exchanges.topic: Revenue Lumpiness & Delivery Timing vs Contract Delays
top_call_exchanges.question: Can you walk through what caused the top-line decline from $5.14M in Q2 to $1.41M in Q3? Were any Novera QPU purchase orders or government milestones cancelled or pushed into future quarters?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Dr. Subodh Kulkarni (CEO): 'None of our contracted projects or Novera pipelines have been cancelled. Our revenue model in this nascent phase is heavily tied to delivery acceptance milestones. In Q2, we recognized multi-system Novera shipments and initial government phases; in Q3, our engineering resources were overwhelmingly committed to validating the Cepheus-1-108Q chiplet architecture and finalizing the $100M CHIPS agreement. We expect acceptance revenue to rebound sharply in Q4 and 2027.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: CHIPS Act $100M Award Tranches & Liquidity Runway
top_call_exchanges.question: With cash at $45.8M and quarterly cash burn around $17M-$26M with CapEx, when will the first capital disbursements from the $100M CHIPS agreement hit the balance sheet, and what are the matching fund requirements?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Dr. Subodh Kulkarni (CEO): 'We have completed the definitive agreement with the Department of Commerce, and the first disbursements are tied to technical milestones across our three R&D initiatives: miniaturized readout electronics, advanced cryogenic cryostats, and high-connectivity chiplet fabrication. We expect initial funding disbursements to begin in the coming quarters, which substantially extends our operational runway into late 2027 without relying on dilutive equity financing.'

top_call_exchanges.topic: Chiplet Modularity vs Monolithic QPU Scaling
top_call_exchanges.question: Achieving 99.5% median fidelity across 108 qubits using twelve tiled 9-qubit chiplets is a technical milestone. How do inter-chip coupler losses compare to on-chip gate speeds, and what is the gating factor to 300+ qubits?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Dr. Subodh Kulkarni (CEO): 'Our proprietary silicon interposer and 3D superconducting interconnect technology enable inter-chiplet quantum logic gates to operate at nearly identical 50-70 nanosecond speeds as on-chip couplers. The primary engineering hurdle to 300+ qubits is cryogenic wiring heat load, which our second CHIPS Act project directly solves by orders of magnitude through next-gen cryostat integration.'
